question: Out of those at the Roswaal estate, which one likes mayonnaise the most? Besides Subaru-kun and Rem.
answer: Liking Mayonnaise Ranking: “Subaru > Beatrice > Emilia > (likes it) > Otto > Roswaal > Frederica > (doesn’t like it) > Ram > Rem >>>>>> Petra. Because Subaru loves mayonnaise, Petra goes along with it, teary-eyed. She’s brave.
